apiTokens.title: API tokens
apiTokens.intro: Tokens let scripts and other programs call the API on your behalf. Send one as "Authorization: Bearer <token>".
apiTokens.name: Name
apiTokens.nameHelp: What the token is for, e.g. "import script".
apiTokens.empty: You have no API tokens yet.
apiTokens.copyNow: Copy the token now. It won't be shown again.
apiTokens.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the token and copy it manually.
apiTokens.revokeMessage: Revoke the token "{{name}}"? Programs using it will lose access immediately.

collectors.title: Collectors
collectors.intro: Collectors are programs that feed streets, house numbers and geo objects into the service in runs. Each one authenticates with its own token.
collectors.name: Name
collectors.expectedIntervalHelp: How often the collector should complete a run. It is marked stale once its last success is twice as old.

statusHelp.never: The collector has not started a run yet.
statusHelp.stale: The last successful run is older than twice the expected interval.
statusHelp.failed: The last run failed, or a run stopped sending for 30 minutes.

collectors.rotateMessage: Create a new token for "{{name}}"? Its current token stops working immediately.
collectors.deleteMessage: Delete "{{name}}" and its token? The data it wrote stays, but no longer belongs to any collector.
